step: turns per tick Q48; signed frequency encoded modulo 2^48; high16 of u64 zero; no implicit two-way factor
reference: offset is validated remaining delay from Target input to selected phase reference plane, not the RAW-reader total; offset <= downstream_latency_ticks. Zero offset names Target input plane.
pipeline: three RF clocks, predicts12GSCticks; output timestamp must match current GSC+offset or valid is false; u64 reference timestamp overflow invalidates
cancel: reset, processing fault, abort, loss of safety/time/clock, epoch loss and DSP completion disable task phase; new task loads frozen parameters
legacy: zero fields => zero-frequency unit phase; old external phase_valid/I/Q ports are not consumed by production replay
limits: Quantized digital phasor, not final full-band/RF phase-accuracy acceptance. Phase modulo wrap is intentional; GSC session rollover still requires system quiesce/restart.
